name: watch-ci-after-push
description: Background CI watcher after every push, reporting pass/fail with failing-job logs.

interface.shortDescription: Background CI watcher after every push.
interface.longDescription: After a git push, finds the workflow runs it triggered, watches them in the background while work continues, and reports pass/fail with failing job names and the relevant log excerpt. Never fire-and-forget, never watch inline.
defaultPrompt: Did the pipeline pass for my last push?
Watch the workflow runs for this commit.
